name: arm9_entry
comment: ARM9 entry point from header

name: mem_fill
comment: assumed from call sites: r0 value; r1 dest; r2 size

name: blz_decompress
comment: game's own BLZ unpacker; r0 = end of compressed data

name: autoload_copy
comment: copies autoload data and clears its bss

name: arm9_autoload_callback
comment: header field 0x70; empty function (bx lr)

name: cp15_init
comment: sets protection regions; caches; ITCM and DTCM

name: main
comment: startup code branches here; contains the endless main loop

name: unpack_data
comment: r0 = data; r1 = mode; used before tile data with a compression type

name: load_palette
comment: r0 = engine; r1 = palette leaf; r2 = offset

name: load_tiles
comment: r0 = engine; r1 = layer; r2 = tile leaf; r3 = offset

name: load_map
comment: r0 = engine; r1 = layer; r2 = map leaf

name: load_file
comment: r0 = path

name: get_member
comment: r0 = container; r1 = index; returns the member address

name: load_bg
comment: r0 = engine; r1 = layer; r2 = palette; r3 = tiles; [sp] = map

name: load_sprite_gfx
comment: r0 = engine; r1 = palette leaf; r2 = tile leaf; slot numbers returned via r3 and [sp]

name: load_bg_record
comment: r0 = container slot; r2 = 10-byte record: palette; tiles; map; engine; ...; layer at +7

name: load_sprite_record
comment: r0 = container slot; r1 = record: tiles; palette; frames; animation

name: update_player_pad
comment: r0 = keys; r1 = pad struct

name: read_input_frame
comment: returns 0 if no shared input is ready; then main skips the tick

name: input_mask_ready
comment: r9 holds the pressed-key mask here; touch sample at [sp]

name: game_init
comment: called once by main; role inferred

name: game_tick
comment: called by main only when read_input_frame returned nonzero; role inferred

name: wh_get_shared_data
comment: r0 = player; returns that player's shared data

name: wh_step_data_sharing
comment: named in its own error message; r0 = send buffer

name: net_state
comment: 0 when wireless is off; otherwise WH state plus 1

name: overlay_checksums
comment: 20 bytes each for 108 overlays; used on download start

name: player_pads
comment: 0x38 bytes per player for 4 players

name: shared_input_buffer
comment: 4 players at 0x26 bytes each; own record at +0x98

name: net_context
comment: bit 0 of byte +0x298 is set while the multiplayer menu is active

name: boot_type
comment: 2 means started by Download Play

name: get_mpd_path
comment: r0 = file index; uses the current language

name: get_message
comment: r0 = (file << 16) | message; returns the text

name: mpd_path_table
comment: 35 path pointers per language

name: minigame_table
comment: 24-byte records indexed by scene; 78 entries

name: get_minigame
comment: r0 = scene; returns the record

name: set_next_mode
comment: r0 = mode; stores to mode_state+0xD

name: scene_of_mode
comment: r0 = mode; returns scene or -1 below mode 0x2C

name: scene_setup_task
comment: task body; runs phase 1 of the current scene

name: scene_manager
comment: endless loop that switches game modes

name: scene_slot
comment: r0 = scene; returns 1 for scene >= 78 else 0

name: load_scene
comment: r0 = scene; loads its overlay unless the slot is occupied

name: unload_scene
comment: r0 = scene

name: run_scene_phase
comment: r0 = scene; r1 = phase

name: irq_disable
comment: sets the I bit; returns the old value

name: irq_restore
comment: r0 = value from irq_disable

name: load_overlay_info
comment: r0 = info; r1 = cpu; r2 = id

name: read_overlay_image
comment: r0 = info

name: start_overlay
comment: r0 = info; checks; unpacks; runs static init

name: run_unload_callbacks
comment: r0 = info; callback list at 0x02163880

name: load_overlay
comment: r0 = cpu; r1 = id

name: unload_overlay
comment: r0 = cpu; r1 = id

name: scene_by_mode
comment: s16 per mode from 0x2C

name: mode_entry_table
comment: u32 entry function per mode

name: scene_overlay
comment: u32 overlay id per scene

name: scene_funcs
comment: 3 u32 per scene: phases 0; 1; 2

name: mode_state
comment: scene and mode bytes used by scene_manager

name: slot_scene
comment: s16 loaded scene per slot

name: arm9_module_params
comment: assumes the first 0x4000 bytes load unchanged

name: arm9_static_bss_start
comment: also autoload_start in module params

name: arm9_autoload_list
comment: from module params

name: arm9_autoload_list_end
comment: equals end of decompressed ARM9 image

name: overlay_slot_1
comment: load address of 74 overlays; equals static_bss_end

name: overlay_slot_2
comment: load address of 34 overlays

name: autoload_itcm
comment: autoload target size 0x5220; inside ITCM per CP15 setup

name: dtcm_base
comment: autoload target size 0xA0 plus bss 0x220; DTCM base per CP15 setup

comment: ARM7 entry point and load address
